title: [4.4+] Inner Classes Leak References and Escape GC
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproduced all the way back to v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]
- Didn't test it farther back.

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - macOS Tahoe (26.3.1) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M2 Max - Apple M2 Max (12 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

After leaving the project running, the process exits in the background with no error message.  In the console it simply shows as being killed.

Minimal reproduction shows that inner classes with references to eachother escape GC and eventually run out of memory.

## Backtrace'd Error from core dump
```
    frame #10: 0x0000000104587c18 godot.macos.editor.arm64`_err_print_error(p_function="add_instance", p_file="core/object/object.cpp", p_line=2453, p_error="FATAL: Condition \"slot_count == (1 << 24)\" is true.", p_message="", p_editor_notify=false, p_type=ERR_HANDLER_ERROR) at error_macros.cpp:126:128 [opt]
```

I have a saved corefile and bin file which are too large to attach to this issue directly but I can use to answer further questions.

Open up the reproduction project.
Leave runing.
Observe memory usage go up until the process silently exits (separate ticket?)
